text:
emma: Opening a small docs PR to streamline Function/Tool Calling examples — swap noisy full JSON dumps for a compact envelope in quickstarts and a single full appendix for integrators. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2421 :eyes:
noah: Compact is great for SDK quickstarts. Strong +1 to keep one canonical full example in an appendix for debugging.
claire: I hit a broken anchor in the migration guide that points to the schema appendix. Include that linkfix in the same PR please.
emma: Will patch the anchor, add docs/appendix/structured-output-full.md, and update snippets/python/invoke_quick.md and snippets/js/invoke_compact.md.
noah: Ops note: runtime now emits `invocation`; older SDKs used `tool_call`. Docs should present `invocation` as canonical and include a parenthetical note — "(legacy: `tool_call`)".
claire: Also add a concise fallback snippet showing compact -> raw_text fallback. Keep it short. Example (py):
```python
resp = client.invoke(...)
out = resp['output'].get('compact')
if not out:
    out = resp['output'].get('raw_text', '')
    # best-effort parse
```
emma: I'll include that and a one-line explanation under the snippet.
sam: Can we add a tiny docs CI lint (simple grep) that ensures invoke snippets include either `compact` or `raw_text`? That'll prevent regression when people edit snippets.
infra-bot: Reminder: add a CHANGELOG entry and mark the PR as docs-only so it skips the release gating.
emma: Yep — link fix, snippet updates, appendix, changelog, and the CI lint will all be in PR 2421. Requesting reviews from @noah and @claire.
noah: I'll run a quick grep for leftover `tool_call` occurrences and open small follow-up PRs if I find any.
claire: Also recommend a short paragraph in the migration guide explaining why compact envelopes reduce token noise and improve parse heuristics. Cross-link that to the appendix.
emma: Good idea — adding that paragraph and the cross-link. Pushing changes now. PR title: "docs: compact invoke envelope + appendix + compat note" (no emojis).
infra-bot: PR updated: link fix applied, snippets modified, changelog added. CI run queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/667788990
noah: Thanks — will review after standup.
